tei:div.tei:p: 493) rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas=

sogs/ hūm̐/ stong chen gsal ba'i rig pa nyid// skad cig sa bon rang gi lhar// gsal bas hūm̐ bskul 'phro 'du las// zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba yis// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer las// mtshon cha rim spros bar chad bskrad// slar 'dus rim bzhin steng 'og gur// dzā la ram gyis me dpung 'bar// rnam rtog 'du shes kun spangs na// bgegs kyi sbyor ba yong mi 'gyur// de bas rnam rtog bgegs yin pas// yang dag rig pa nyid kyi srungs// ye nas gnyis med chos skur dag pa las// ma rig dbang gi sgro dang bskur btab ste// bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin// de ldog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam nos te// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis// bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pas// rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyod la bzod par gsol// (494)ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis// phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi rig 'dzin dang*// sdom pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas bzung ba ltar// de nas bdag kyang lam chen der zhugs te// 'gro la phan phyir de dag bzung bar bgyi// oṃ hūm̐ a la la ho// bha ga wān sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ha s+t+waṃ/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab// khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la bab// byin gyis brlabs pa'i= dbang mchog bskur ba'i= dngos grub stsol ba'i dus= mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das/ byin chen byin phob= dbang chen dbang bskur= dngos grub mchog stsol= bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las// rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bu// dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur// oṃ shṛ badz+ra rā ga dhu pe dhu/ puṣ+pe (495)pu/

a lo ke hriḥ ghan+dhe ghan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hriḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ta ba la bā te gu h+ya sa ma ye swa hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ha rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ 496)
